nota: Fotografie GENERATE con Higgsfield (modello gpt_image_2_5, qualità high, 2k) il 2026-10-14, su richiesta esplicita del committente («puoi usare higgsfield per generare immagini dove servono»). Riferimenti di stile: le foto del cliente hand-contract e hand-graduation (assets-src → src/assets/webp). Non sono foto del cliente: vanno dichiarate come immagini generate se il cliente lo richiede. Nessuna persona riconoscibile: solo mani. Varianti web con alfa ricavata dalla luminanza: tools/foto.mjs.
stile_comune: Editorial advertising studio photograph in the exact visual style of the reference images: human hands in black-and-white (monochrome charcoal tone, high contrast, finely textured skin), one object in vivid saturated orange (#FF7A00), selective color. Background: flat seamless very dark charcoal near-black (#121115), no gradient, no props. Soft key light from the upper left, subtle rim light. No text, no logos, no watermark.

contro-caduta.scena: two hands reach toward each other from left and right but fail to meet; below the gap a smooth matte orange cube with softly rounded edges is falling, tilted, slightly motion-blurred

passaggio-1.scena: a hand from the lower left, palm up, hands over the orange cube to a second hand from the right that takes it from above with fingertips, exchange at the center

passaggio-2.scena: the left hand holds the orange cube between thumb and fingers and places it into the open cupped palm of the right hand, diagonal from lower left to upper right

passaggio-3.scena: a strong hand from the right grips the orange cube firmly, having just received it; on the left the other hand's fingers open as they let go

finale-trofeo.scena: an arm rises vertically from the bottom edge and the hand holds the orange cube high like a trophy, the cube glowing faintly

metodo-scalinata.scena: a hand places the last small orange cube on top of a zig-zag staircase of orange cubes of different sizes

risultati-scontrino.scena: a hand rises from the bottom holding a long strip of orange paper receipt that unrolls and curls upward in an S-shaped ribbon, no legible text

dna-bussola.scena: a hand holds an open orange pocket compass presented toward the camera, no legible lettering

eventi-biglietto.scena: a hand raises an orange event admission ticket with a perforated stub between two fingers, no legible text

fatturare-microfono.scena: a hand grips an orange vintage broadcast studio microphone, holding it up as if about to speak

candidatura-caffe.scena: a hand offers an orange espresso cup on a matching saucer toward the camera, a thin wisp of steam
